description: This file is a C source file implementing DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and a proxy decryption function for PlayReady DRM system. It includes functions to initialize/deinitialize the platform and to perform a DRM decrypt operation that interacts with external components like the AV buffer manager.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform library, returning success status.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform library, returning success status.
